name: job.fit
description: Project Get a Job: qualify one posting for Mike Rodgers (Head of AI / AI strategy & enablement / senior customer-facing AI deployment). Comp floor $250K all-in, reach $325K. Routes to skip / apply / warm-intro-first.

comp_band.instructions: Total compensation this posting most plausibly pays, using the posted range and any bonus/equity language. If no number is posted, infer from title, company size and seniority.
criteria: All-in $200K-$250K, or unposted with a director-level title
All-in $250K-$325K, or unposted with a VP/Head-of title at a company that pays at that level
All-in $325K or more, stated or strongly implied

role_shape.instructions: Which shape best describes the job as written

criteria.head_of_ai: Owns AI strategy, governance and adoption for a business unit or company
criteria.customer_facing_ai_deployment: Deployment strategist, forward deployed, solutions or advisory role embedded with customers
criteria.ai_product_or_transformation_leader: Director/VP of AI product, transformation or enablement inside an enterprise
criteria.deep_engineering_ic: Individual contributor requiring years of hands-on ML research or large-scale systems engineering
criteria.not_a_fit: Unrelated function (finance, legal, HR, creative, medical, etc.)

hard_disqualifier.instructions: The posting requires something the candidate does not have: a PhD, an active security clearance, a specific professional license, 10+ years managing software engineering teams, or a named vendor certification as a must-have

seniority_match.instructions: The seniority is Director, Senior Director, VP, Head-of or C-level. Manager-and-below or pure IC is not a match

adoption_story_fits.instructions: A candidate whose proof is enterprise AI adoption, telehealth rollout across hospital systems, Oracle/Cerner strategy, and hands-on governed AI builds would be a credible finalist for this role

rules.reason: quota seat, not the target lane
seniority unclear; human reads the JD
in band -- warm-intro lane, do not cold-apply first

notes: Created 2026-09-18 from the audit: 98 of 639 salaried discoveries clear a $200K floor, 25 clear $250K. Rank verb is the first use; check stays advisory until labelled against Mike's own skip/apply decisions.
